_comment: The approval request a worker gate builds (agent/src/hooks.py, step 5) and sends to the trusted approval writer (cdk/src/handlers/request-approval.ts), without the ttl that the worker drops before sending. agent/tests/test_hooks.py checks that the hook builds exactly these fields, agent/tests/test_approval_requests.py sends this row, and cdk/test/handlers/request-approval.test.ts and request-approval-local.test.ts validate and store it, so a field added on one side only fails a test. The hook always sends a timeout of at least approval_timeout_s.min with deadline_epoch = created_at + timeout_s.
